decisions.base: Combine all 3 series into one 750-card base pool with equal odds.
decisions.rookies: 45 indexed true RCs, independent check against full base checklist.
decisions.firstDay: 750 First Day Production physical pack parallels, 1:24 in each original series, 2000 copies per number.
decisions.insertCards: Include 3000 Hit Club/Expansion Draft (4), Expansion Team Firsts (2), Superstar Duos (4), and physically pack-included Master Photo redemption cards (12+12+6).
decisions.excluded: Exclude Members Only factory-set parallels and factory-only inserts, redeemed 5x7 Master Photos, Membership Forms and Info Cards as non-playing promotional paperwork.
decisions.nameRule: Strip only whitespace-delimited whole metadata tokens; never truncate surnames ending in token-looking characters.
decisions.pack: Four-card VCS packs and 24 packs per box; source odds per original series displayed but unified VCS odds require final normalization.
decisions.release: DRAFT. Verify imported artwork, pricing, team data, and normalization of series-specific insert odds before release.
